entries.question: Kya hospital Sunday open rahta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU ki OPD services Sunday ko band rehti hain. OPD ka samay Somvar (Monday) se Shukravar (Friday) tak subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak aur Shanivar (Saturday) ko subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 12:00 baje tak hota hai.

Halanki, **Emergency aur Trauma Centre ki services 24/7 khuli rehti hain.**

Yadi aapko medical salah ki zaroorat hai, toh kripya doctor se sampark karein. Main medical salah dene ke liye yogya nahi hoon. Apni suraksha ke liye chat mein apni niji swasthya jankari (personal health details), Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.

entries.question: Emergency mey doctor neurologist or spine ke doctor milenge
entries.answer:
Emergency mein sabse pehle aapko **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** jaana chahiye. Wahan par Emergency Medicine ke doctors uplabdh hote hain jo marij ko stabilize karte hain.

KGMU mein Neurology aur Neurosurgery (Spine) ke visheshagya (specialists) emergency mein on-call rehte hain. Trauma Centre ke doctors sthiti ko dekhkar turant in departments ke doctors ko consult (bulwa) sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn jankari:**
*   **Emergency:** Seedhe Trauma Centre (Gate 14) jayein.
*   **Medical Sahayata:** Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical diagnosis ya treatment ki salah nahi de sakta. Kripya turant KGMU ke Emergency department mein doctor ko dikhayein.
*   **Suraksha:** Apni niji swasthya jankari, jaise ki mareez ka naam, phone number ya koi bhi personal details is chat mein share na karein.

Yadi sthiti gambhir hai, toh bina deri kiye Trauma Centre pahunchein.

*   **General & Pediatric Emergency:** You should go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.
*   **Availability:** The Trauma Centre functions 24/7 with specialized teams, including Neurosurgery and Orthopedics (Spine), to handle emergencies.

entries.question: Aaj Sam mey jae to doctor mil jaenge
entries.answer:
जी हाँ, KGMU का **ट्रॉमा सेंटर (इमरजेंसी) 24/7 खुला रहता है**, इसलिए आप आज शाम को भी वहाँ जा सकते हैं। वहाँ हमेशा डॉक्टर और विशेषज्ञ (Specialist) ड्यूटी पर मौजूद रहते हैं।

**कुछ जरूरी बातें ध्यान रखें:**

1.  **इमरजेंसी:** अगर स्थिति गंभीर है (जैसे चोट, दुर्घटना, या कोई अचानक हुई स्वास्थ्य समस्या), तो सीधे **गेट नंबर 14 (ट्रॉमा सेंटर)** पर जाएँ।
2.  **ओपीडी (OPD):** अगर आपकी समस्या सामान्य है और आप ओपीडी में दिखाना चाहते हैं, तो ध्यान रखें कि ओपीडी का समय **सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक** ही होता है (शनिवार को दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। **शाम को ओपीडी बंद रहती है।**
3.  **परामर्श:** यदि आपको किसी विशेष विभाग (जैसे न्यूरोलॉजी या स्पाइन) के विशेषज्ञ को दिखाना है और स्थिति इमरजेंसी नहीं है, तो बेहतर होगा कि आप कल सुबह ओपीडी के समय में आएँ या ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (www.ors.gov.in) बुक करें।

**चेतावनी:** मैं चिकित्सा सलाह देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। यदि मरीज की हालत बहुत गंभीर है, तो कृपया बिना देर किए सीधे ट्रॉमा सेंटर के इमरजेंसी विभाग में ही जाएँ। अपना और मरीज का ध्यान रखें।

entries.question: I want to book appointment in Lari hospital
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at the LARI Cardiology department, you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online Portal:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh as the state and KGMU as the hospital, then follow the steps to book an appointment for Cardiology.
*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA or the ORS patient portal app to book your slot.
*   **SMS Service:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
*   **Phone:** You may call the KGMU help desk at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Mandatory Registration:** Online registration is highly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid medical referral for the Cardiology department.
*   **Identity:** I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: How to get admission in kgmu without neet
entries.answer:
Admission to MBBS and BDS courses at King George's Medical University is strictly governed by national regulations. It is **not possible** to get admission to MBBS or BDS programs at KGMU without qualifying for the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test).

For other courses (such as Paramedical, Nursing, or specific certificate courses), KGMU may conduct its own entrance examinations or follow specific state-level counseling processes. 

I recommend visiting the official admissions page to check the requirements for the specific course you are interested in: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

If you have any further questions, I am here to help.

entries.question: Appointment Lena hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein appointment lene ke liye aap niche diye gaye kisi bhi tarike ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **Online Portal (ORS):** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par login karke aap apni pasand ka department aur samay chun sakte hain.
2. **Mobile App:** Aap 'ABHA' ya 'Health Care' app ka upyog kar sakte hain.
3. **SMS Booking:** "Appointment [Patient Name]" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.
4. **Phone Se:** Aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke bhi jaankari le sakte hain.
5. **Walk-in (Hospital aakar):** Aap seedhe KGMU aakar registration counter par apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number dikhakar bhi parchi (ticket) banwa sakte hain.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   OPD parchi ki fees ₹50 hai.
*   OPD counter subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak khule rehte hain (Shaniwar ko 12:00 baje tak).
*   Online booking ki salah di jaati hai taaki aapko lambi line mein na lagna pade.
*   Agar aap shehar se bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne department se sambandhit referral saath layein.

**Medical Advice Disclaimer:** Main ek AI assistant hoon aur doctor nahi hoon. Agar aapko koi gambhir samasya ya emergency hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke Trauma Centre (Gate 14) jayein. Apni sehat se judi niji jaankari (jaise ki bimari ya reports) yahan share na karein.

entries.question: Bina interest exam ke addmission nahi mil skta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi academic course (jaise B.Sc. Radiology) mein bina entrance exam ke direct admission ka koi pravdhan (provision) nahi hai. 

KGMU ek premier medical university hai aur yahan sabhi courses mein admission **merit-based entrance examination** ke madhyam se hi hota hai. Iske bina admission sambhav nahi hai.

Agar aap admission lena chahte hain, toh aapko university dwara conduct kiye jaane wale entrance exam ke liye apply karna hoga aur usmein qualify karna hoga. Admission process se judi sabhi adhikarik jaankari ke liye aap yahan check kar sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

Kisi bhi tarah ke "direct admission" ya bina exam ke admission ke daavon se savdhan rahein, kyunki yeh fraud ho sakte hain. Hamesha official website par di gayi jaankari par hi bharosa karein.

entries.question: To resistance date to nikal gai
entries.answer:
Agar B.Sc. ya kisi specific course ke liye entrance exam ki registration date nikal chuki hai, toh iska matlab hai ki us academic session ke liye applications band ho chuki hain.

KGMU mein admission ke liye university ki timeline follow karna bahut zaroori hai. Yahan kuch points hain jo aapko dhyaan mein rakhne chahiye:

1. **Official Website Check Karein:** Aap [kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jakar 'Notice Board' ya 'Admission' section dekhte rahein. Kabhi-kabhi agar seats khali rehti hain ya koi special notification aati hai, toh wahi update milti hai.
2. **Agla Session:** Agar date nikal chuki hai, toh ab aapko agle saal (Next Academic Session) ke liye taiyari karni hogi. Entrance exam ke notifications aam taur par exam se 2-3 mahine pehle aate hain.
3. **Fraud se Savdhan:** Main phir se kehna chahunga ki kisi bhi aise vyakti ya agent par bharosa na karein jo "date nikalne ke baad" ya "bina exam ke" admission dilwane ka vaada kare. KGMU mein aisa koi process nahi hai.

Agar aapko lagta hai ki koi technical error hua hai ya aap kisi aur course ke baare mein pooch rahe hain, toh aap university ke **Admission Cell** ya **Registrar Office** se direct contact kar sakte hain. 

Registrar Office ka contact number: **0522-2253171**

Kya aapne kisi specific course ke liye apply karne ki koshish ki thi? Main aapko agle saal ki taiyari ke liye sahi disha dikha sakta hoon.

entries.question: To kya agar seat khali rahega to mujhe college mil skta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein seats khali rehne par bhi admission ka ek nirdharit (defined) process hota hai, jise **"Mop-up Round"** ya **"Spot Counseling"** kaha jata hai.

Iske baare mein kuch zaroori baatein samajh lijiye:

1. **Counseling ke bina admission nahi:** Agar entrance exam ke baad kuch seats khali reh jati hain, toh university un seats ko bharnay ke liye ek notice nikalti hai jise "Mop-up round counseling" kehte hain. Ismein wahi students participate kar sakte hain jinhone entrance exam diya tha aur jo merit list mein eligible hain.
2. **Direct Entry Sambhav Nahi:** Agar aapne entrance exam nahi diya hai, toh seat khali rehne par bhi aapko admission nahi mil sakta. KGMU mein koi bhi seat "Direct" ya "Walk-in" nahi bhari jati.
3. **Merit List:** Admission hamesha merit list ke aadhar par hota hai. Agar seats khali rehti hain, toh merit list mein niche ke rank wale students ko mauka diya jata hai, lekin unka entrance exam mein shamil hona anivarya (mandatory) hota hai.

**Sallah (Advice):**
*   **Fraud se bachein:** Agar koi aapko keh raha hai ki "seat khali hai, paise do aur admission le lo," toh woh dhokha hai. Aise logo se door rahein.
*   **Official Notice Board:** Aap [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko check karte rahein. Agar koi bhi "Spot Counseling" ya "Mop-up round" ka notice aata hai, toh wahi sahi aur kanooni rasta hai.

Agar aapne is saal ka entrance exam nahi diya hai, toh agle saal ki taiyari shuru karna hi sabse behtar vikalp hai.
